notes: v0.3.76: ASIO reliability fix. Stops the Focusrite USB ASIO from silently falling back to WASAPI shared mode (high latency + static) on connect. Removed the redundant pre-flight ASIO enumeration that was thrashing the USB driver; added settle time + progressive retry so slower laptop USB can re-init in time. Fast machines unaffected. ASIO fallback now clearly labeled in diagnostics. 48kHz warning restored as an inline Setup-screen banner.
